scope: Real rendered Chromium page, production commands, Chrome API shim over Playwright pipe; not MV3 or native messaging

evidence.title: Command dispatcher ping via test shim (not native transfer)

Real AX roles, name, value and bounds
Real wait: selector and text in iframe; absent marker times out
Set and read back a Cyrillic field
Explicit empty value reaches browser handler
Trusted input and Ctrl+A/Backspace verified by actual field state
Trusted button click happens only in intended tab
Navigation and stale AX invalidation; new page confirmed
Release closes the real browser CDP session in the shim
